title: Close the complaint gap in the simulated launch panel
requested_by: orchestrator, after CEILING-2 showed complaint recall at 0.77x of the human ceiling
registered_at: 2026-11-25 (registered in the ledger after assignment; design text as sent to the subagent)
question: Can the deployed panel recall real complaints as well as a real half-panel does?
design: Same 22 launches and stored half-B complaints as CEILING-2, equal-size subsamples, same scorer. Diagnose missed complaints into 3-6 kinds. Arms vs deployed panel: (a) persona prompt adds 'what would stop you using this, be specific'; (b) person-built comments from held people whose past comments were mostly critical. Report complaint recall and precision as fraction of ceiling with paired intervals. Prompts use only launch-page / line-up fields before the day.
scoring_fixed_before_results: CEILING-2 scorer and half-B complaint sets, stored before COMPLAINT-1 started
notes: Only 22 launches; arm (a) and (b) were chosen by the orchestrator without a pilot.

title: Simulated cohort users use each night's structural top 15 and two same-category competitors in a browser
requested_by: orchestrator 00:17Z Nov 25 (+ amendment 00:23Z), access rule from Shreyas via orchestrator 06:03Z Nov 25
registered_at: 2026-11-25T21:30Z in this ledger (design pre-registered in PREREG.md addendum 11, 11a-11e, before the first frozen night; ledger rule arrived 21:24Z Nov 25)
question: Does using the product (would-use x preference from simulated cohort users) re-order the structural top 15 toward the real ranking, and do their first-use findings match launch-day comments, better than the homepage-prompt control and Stage B?
design: Nightly from PT launch day 2026-11-26. Line-up frozen at 01:20 PT: structural top 15, 2 same-category competitors (CATEGORY-1 leaders / nightly Similar Products), category core task (frozen v2 prompt), 4 users = first 4 of the person-built panel selection (PREREG 11c). Sessions on the MCP server seed VMs, Gemini 2.5 Flash driver, 2 waves, max 40 turns, no new session after 03:25 PT; per-user Gemini debrief (temperature 0). Access failures (signup_wall, captcha, block, js_only, timeout, engine) are excluded from every prediction and score; product traits (card_required, onboarding_broken, platform_only) stay findings (11e). Controls: homepage-only prompt (control_homepage.py) and Stage B yes_share.
scoring_fixed_before_results: score.py: (1) residual: capture of the real top 3 / 5 when the top 15 is re-ordered by sim_score minus the structural order, and within-day Spearman of sim_score with (real rank - structural rank), for sim, stageb and homepage arms; launches with no clean session keep their structural place. (2) product reaction: forward_says.judge recall / precision / complaint recall against the frozen consensus truth from launch-day comments (layer-2 truth = launch-day comments only, orchestrator 05:39Z Nov 25), sim vs homepage control. First read at 7 scored days, reported once. review_cal.py (competitors vs post-cutoff PH reviews) is calibration only.

deviations.why: E5 at its $15 split after PU-0

deviations.what: layer-2 truth: reviews -> launch-day comments only
no Nov 25 dress rehearsal (pre-first-night runs skip unless PU_REHEARSE=1)
access failures excluded from all predictions and scores; preference re-ranked among clean sessions; sim_score null for launches with no clean session
deviations.why: access problems are not product signal

deviations.what: access work (accounts, playbooks) moved to the signup agent session_01WkCrULer75dbfV12Unm3BZ; runner reads its access_playbook.json (v1); no-account-path instruction removed; signup-wording fix and Google sign-in tool kept

deviations.why: 4/40 wave-2 logins failed on the Nov 24 rerun

title: Live-vs-backtest parity read for the Nov 24 published 00:05 line (structural bug-fix scope)
registered_at: 2026-11-25T21:45Z, AFTER the analysis ran (21:25-21:44Z): the ledger rule arrived at 21:24Z while the read was in progress; the orchestrator asked for this row
question: For the Nov 24 real #3/#5/#7 (published #18/#16/#17) and real #10 (absent at 00:05): which arm-3 inputs were missing or defaulted at 00:05 but present the next day; was real #10 a late add; is the 22-day live top 10 of 70.5 vs 75-78 backtest a known input difference?
design: (1) Compare raw/daily/2026-11-24/arm3_inputs_2026-11-24.parquet (live 00:05 inputs, 62) with the same 62 inputs rebuilt next day by struct_bt_vm.py (SAVE_INPUTS_FROM=2026-11-23; month-forward, trained < Nov 1), per launch: live-null-but-backtest-present and value differences. (2) Real #10 membership in today_0005.json (00:05 line-up) vs lineup_0100.json. (3) Live 00:05 published top 10 vs the STRUCT-BT26 backtest top 10 on the same live days (truth_daily ranks).
scoring_fixed_before_results: descriptive read, no hypothesis test: counts of null/differing inputs; membership flags; mean top-10 hit share live vs backtest on identical days
what_ran: as designed; the VM rerun of struct_bt_vm.py with SAVE_INPUTS_FROM (304 s, scratch data root)

deviations.what: row registered after the run, not before
deviations.why: the ledger rule arrived during the read; recorded here as a deviation

results.differences: every within-day relative input shifts with the 42 vs 44 line-up; training-window inputs differ (txt_ridge, comp_nn_*, A_fol_pct_in_topic, A_same_strong_*: live trained through Nov 23, backtest through Oct 31); real #5 gained a maker after 00:05 (ph_n_makers 3 -> 4)
results.real10_late_add: yes: featuredAt 2026-11-24T08:00Z but not in the 00:05 line-up read (42); present in the 01:00 re-read (44)
results.reading: no missing-input bug; Nov 24 is mostly a model miss (backtest also has real #5/#7 outside its top 10) plus two late line-up adds; the 70.5 vs 75-78 gap is day mix (these November days are harder for the backtest too), not a live input difference

cost_basis: about 5 min on the already-running pipeline VM; no API calls
decision: no fix proposed; reported to the orchestrator

title: Structural backtest for every 2026 day (arm-3 month-forward) with pred_votes
registered_at: 2026-11-25T21:45Z, retroactively (ran 14:34-14:41Z, before the ledger rule existed)
question: Provide a leak-free arm-3 structural score, rank and predicted final votes for every 2026 day Jan 1 - Nov 24, so TARGETS-0 can score more than 24 weeks.
design: struct_bt_vm.py = the PH-KNN1 arm3_live replica (same frame, 62 inputs, params, 5 seeds), test month trained on days before it; struct_bt_write.py writes results/structural/backtest/<day>.json (existing format) plus pred_votes = expm1(a + b*score) * Duan smear, a/b fitted month-forward on earlier months' OOS rows.
scoring_fixed_before_results: checks: replica vs stored arm-3 Spearman; out-of-sample daily sum(pred_votes)/sum(real) median and p10-p90; median per-launch |log error|
what_ran: as designed (VM 304 s); 328 day files, 7,422 launches

deviations.what: the 191 existing files were overwritten: arm 3 is now the replica on every day; arm-2 scores kept where present; Nov 10-22 live frozen scores replaced by month-forward ones
deviations.why: one consistent series; the live record stays in raw/daily/<d>/forecast_<d>.parquet

cost_basis: VM minutes on the running pipeline VM; no API calls
